formula.gdp: (pop_m*1 + civ*8 + mil*4 + dock*6 + finance*12 + services*5) * dd_prod
formula.dd_prod: real 2026 GDP / formula at the start. One number per country. Focuses may change it.

notes: Revenue and program spending are shares of a live GDP. Productivity is stamped in country history so 1 Jan 2026 GDP matches the real figure. No per-country tax or spending weight. Low tax is 18% of GDP, so the US starts near an 18% take and about 24% spending including interest. Universal health and top-tier education are priced so France's high-tier basket lands near 40% of GDP.
